name: Chaos Wall
description: A wall where Tezzeret was ejected and the Weftwinder makes its home.

timeline.summary: The Weftwinder emerges and makes its home within the Chaos Wall.
timeline.quote: Able to burrow beyond the tangible, to hollow the Weft as one might bore tunnels through earth, the Weftwinder has found its home within the Chaos Wall.

pages_say.description: The barrier of howling recombinant particles at one end of the annular universe, which FTL travel pierces.
A wall where Tezzeret was ejected and the Weftwinder makes its home.
